name: Saved report
description: Shows a saved report as a sortable, paginated table or a chart, run with the permissions of the person filling in the form. Optionally pick a row as the field's value.

props.name: report_id
props.label: Saved report
props.description: The report's id (open it in Reports — the id is in the address bar). People see only what they can see in Reports: their own or shared reports, with their permissions.

options.label: Automatic (the report's chart, else a table)

props.name: max_rows
props.label: Maximum rows
props.description: Rows fetched from the report (at most 1,000). A note says when there are more.

props.name: selectable
props.label: Selectable rows
props.description: Picking a row makes that row (an object of its columns) the field's value. Otherwise the field stays empty.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab through the view switch, Refresh, the column headers (Enter or Space sorts; again reverses), the row select buttons (when rows are selectable; Enter or Space picks / unpicks) and Previous / Next. The table scrolls sideways inside its own frame on narrow screens.

author: UserTasks
